messages.subject: problem with quantile normalization?
parts:
Hi Henrik,
I just got an error in the quantile normalization. The error says that
no applicable method for 'getExclCells' exists (the only methods are
getExclCells.DChipQuantileNormalization, so that's true enough...) --
it's called by 'calculateTargetDistribution'. I'm using the new version
you sent me to check so it might be that. I haven't done quantile
normalization from scratch since the very beginning (now I'm trying to
do the analysis on a new set of exon arrays) so I don't when this
happens. I installed the older version 0.4.3 and it ran happily.
Best,
Elizabeth

Hi, FYI: think is a problem related to a version that only Elizabeth
got and that we are trying out to fix all the recent problems since
release v0.4.4. Thus, this message does not apply to anyone else.

/Henrik
